fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our annual fuel consumption over the last 12 months, a hypothetical 10% increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased aircraft fuel expense by approximately $58 million.

instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel derivative contracts outstanding as of December 31, 2021. Company historically used out-of-the-money call options; entered collars in 2019 that resulted in losses when fuel fell in 2020. Program appears to have been discontinued.

warnings: Frontier used fuel collars in 2019 that resulted in significant payment obligations in 2020 when fuel prices fell; no hedging since then
